creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`./dev --contract`'s `a_pane_that_does_not_exist_says_why` failed twice on 2026-11-18 with `adapter.refresh.failed`, reason `signal: 15 (SIGTERM)`, on a branch that touched none of it. The test stops the app as soon as `app.ready` appears, which sends SIGTERM to the whole process group; the background adapter refresh is still waiting on its CLI child, logs the child's end as a warning, and the test rejects any warning. The Swift `SurfaceGUITests` run after the launch checks, so they did not run either.

Keep the check asserting that no unexpected warning appears; give it a way to let the adapter refresh finish, or to stop the app without that refresh logging its own child's SIGTERM as a failure.

Agent-approved under the first test as a defect fix: a flaky check in a tier's suite. It changes nothing a user sees and adds no interface.
title: The contract check for a missing pane fails when the app is stopped mid adapter refresh
